vintage_model.query_contract: latest vintage where available_at_utc <= snapshot_time_utc and timestamp certainty matches resolution
vintage_model.zero_mutation_guarantee: Vintages are immutable frozen dataclasses stored in immutable tuples; revisions are appended
vintage_model.historical_reconstruction_rule: An old snapshot evaluated on series that later underwent revisions returns strictly the vintage that was available at that historical snapshot time.
